name: Face Saddle Detection
aliases: Saddle Point Detection on Shared Face
definition: A point p on the shared face of two cells is a saddle point if the trilinear interpolants degenerate to the same bilinear interpolant on that face, and two specific conditions regarding the bilinear saddle and the sign of a derived expression are met.
summary: Face Saddle Detection distinguishes true 3D saddle points from false positives on shared faces by verifying connectivity consistency across adjacent trilinear cells.
